## Rule

Periodic 29x29 inpaint: the input is a tiled color pattern with black color-0 holes. Output restores every hole from the same periodic orbit, i.e. `out[r,c] = pattern[r mod p_v, c mod p_h]`, and the 30x30 one-hot canvas outside row/col 0..28 must remain all-zero.

## Algorithm sketch

**CURRENT LIVE = Sho's 5145 `bianfu3` linear-vote family (opset 17, F32 output, argmax/threshold decode) — NOT the old sub-8k compact-tile family below.** Sho's graph: detect the row period p in {4..9} from a col-1 color signature via 4-probe period-validity checks + a Not/And/Or priority chain (-> one-hot RowSel); then a single fused Einsum `par,pah,mp,mwk,bchk,c->bcrw` does **row-orbit majority-vote** (v_w4 = rank-p residue banks build M_p[r,h]; holes excluded by v_w3[0]=0) with a gated period-9 column patch (mode-1). The grader decodes via `(out>0)` threshold + exact one-hot match, so the render must be exactly one-hot (any fractional leak to a wrong channel fails).

_Old sub-8k compact-tile family (stale, pre-Sho): collapse one-hot to a 29x29 label plane, score compact period probes, gather rows/cols by mod(arange, period), pad+Equal to BOOL output._

Three byte-equal transforms (all AB n2000 byte-equal to Sho): **(1)** col-operator `v_w5[2,30,30]=1800` -> ragged `Bcol[38,30]=1140` (29 identity residue-cols + rank-9 period-9 residue-cols), `ColSelMask=ones29 ++ Expand(gate,9)`. **(2)** ROW bank `v_w4[6,9,30]=1620` (rank-9 padded) -> ragged `B_row[39,30]=1170` (residues for periods 4..9, no padding), `RowSelMask[39]=Cast(Equal(colperiod[39], rowsel.periodvec))`. **(3)** detection color/arith tensors F32->F16 (integer colors 0..9 exact). Render is one fused Einsum `jr,jh,j,iw,ik,i,bchk,c->bcrw`. Named delta vs Sho: params -1037, memory -181.

**WALL for the linear-vote route at ~3900 (forced components, priced):**
- **(A) Render residue banks ~2310 params forced.** The copy structure for periods {4..9} + col identity + period-9 patch, as ragged residue one-hots (each residue-col once). Proven optimal by building the **genuinely-different alternative** that computes the maps from `arange+Mod+Equal` (NO banks): params drop to 364 but it materializes [30,30] F32 maps (3600 B each) -> **scores 6431, +2500 WORSE** (`prototypes/w2_worker2/task110_alt_computedmap.onnx`). Root cause = the scorer's 4x asymmetry (F32 intermediate 4 B/elem vs param 1/elem; input/output uncharged). Storing the copy structure as params is memory-optimal; computing it is not.
- **(B) Period detection ~900 forced** (Sho's validated 4-probe checker + period-9 gate); leaner detection risks the 99.35% truth and byte-equality.
- **(C) Ragged select masks ~385 memory** = price of de-padded banks (still net -206 vs padded, since padding waste 450 > mask 244).
- No period-conditioned copy cheaper than a residue bank exists on this op set: MaxPool-orbit needs p|30 (fails p in {4,7,8,9}); Scatter-max needs a [10,30,30] INT index; dynamic-step Slice yields dynamic shapes -> scorer returns None (banned). Prompt `floor_est ~1200` is a TopK heuristic mismatched to this orbit-vote task.

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._

### 2026-07-11 - Priced dead/marginal routes below Sho 5145 (bo_ng_cld_worker2)
- **INT8 detection narrowing: BLOCKED.** ORT has NO `Where(INT8)` kernel (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Where(16)`), and INT16/UINT16 has no arithmetic kernel at any opset. Sho's detector uses `Where`, so **F16 is the narrowest usable dtype** (used in v6). Don't retry INT8 for a Where-containing chain.
- **Shared ragged bank B[68,30] for rows+cols: NET +86 WORSE.** Saves 720 render params but the two [68] F32 select-mask intermediates (RowSelMask+ColSelMask) add +512B memory > the -426 net param gain. Root cause = the KEY scorer asymmetry: **F32 intermediate = 4 B/elem, param = 1/elem, and graph `input`/`output` are uncharged** (`calculate_memory` L234). Keep rows on `v_w4[6,9,30]` (RowSel[6] direct, no mask); only cols pay a mask.
- **Materializing any [30,30] map (row/col operator) as an intermediate: always loses** (3600 B F32) vs storing it as a param (≤900). All render maps must stay fused-Einsum operands. This kills every "build C=identity+εM_p at runtime" idea.
- **ε-weighted / fractional-vote fallbacks: BROKEN by the grader.** Decode is `(out>0)` threshold + exact one-hot match, NOT argmax. Any fractional leak to a wrong channel -> extra 1 -> fail. The render must be exactly one-hot; only same-color (uniform-orbit) votes may be added.
- **Pure 2D-orbit-vote (reuse v_w4 for cols, drop v_w5, ~3156 params): fails 2 rectangular OFFICIAL examples** (train1 7x42, test 9x18) which need col-identity; hidden is always square so it's tempting, but visible must be 266/266. A RectFlag+ragged-identity fix restores 266/266 (verified 266 + 1500 fresh) but the extra [68] col-mask memory cancels the saving.

### 2026-06-22 - GatherND direct output via FREE F32 input: NO-CANDIDATE, floor proved (worker-5)
**Lever:** GatherND(input F32[1,10,30,30], modular_index_pairs) → output BOOL[1,10,30,30], dissolving U8 carrier + Equal tail.
**Why it fails:** GatherND on F32 input outputs F32[1,10,30,30]; a Cast(F32→BOOL) is needed before the BOOL output node. The F32[1,10,30,30] IS a charged intermediate (36,000B, not the graph output node). Profiled: static==profile==54,000 (6.9× worse than 7,852). The only way to make GatherND output FREE is if it IS the graph output, but the output must be BOOL, not F32.
**GatherND on label29 with STATIC indices:** Probe B (period=9 hardcoded) = 7,657. But data-dependent period selection requires a runtime INT64 index tensor [1,1,29,29,2] = 13,456B intermediate — catastrophic. Static-period approach is functionally wrong (misses other periods).
**Compact-tile tail is the irreducible floor:** 9-row compact tile (261B) padded to 10×30 (300B) → row-Gathered to 30×30 (900B) → Equal → output (FREE). Any direct-indexing approach on 29×29 or 30×30 tensors materializes 841+841+900=2,582B for just those steps vs 261+300+900=1,461B current. Cannot beat current tail.
